Items 404

Every item you can actually get hold of. Tools, food and fish also have their own sections below.

Armour has been retired. The 20 pieces (helm, chestplate, leggings, boots across 5 tiers) are not listed here: nothing crafts one, there is no slot to wear one in and carrying one does not reduce damage. Skills do that job now. If an old save still holds a piece, it converts once into skill points - floor(points / 3), never less than 1 - and a merchant will still buy it.

Crops are in Blocks. The 28 growth stages are not items you can hold: plant a seed on watered farmland and harvest the ripe stage. Each stage is listed under Blocks with what breaking it gives.
